items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: at rehearsal I looked at the fellows in the band, and there sat James Moody and Joe Gales.

ctx.x: So -- well, what happened then? So you got in touch with Dizzy.
Yeah. Well, I showed up at rehearsal, as I was telling you, when I came home, and at rehearsal I looked at the fellows in the band, and there sat James Moody and Joe Gales.
